defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Innkeeping.label: innkeeping
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Innkeeping.descrip: Room classes, price tiers, the tavern, the front desk, the hitching post and the first paid dishes. Everything a house needs once the first guests stay a second night. Unlocks the smoker, the oven, the guest altar and learning level 2 of the kitchen.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Gastronomy.label: gastronomy
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Gastronomy.descrip: Menus, waiters, kitchen styles and a proper dining room. Unlocks the steamer, the wok station, the cold station and learning level 3 of the kitchen.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_HotelManagement.de: Booking terminals, arrival forecasts, shifts and the deep fryer. The difference between an inn and a hotel is that a hotel knows who is coming.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_FineDining.label: fine dining
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_FineDining.descrip: Linen, sommeliers and critics. Learning level 4 of the kitchen: the Signature form of every dish.
defs.WorkTypeDef/HH_Hosting.description: Check guests in and out, show them around, keep them entertained and talk them into staying (or joining).
defs.WorkTypeDef/HH_Serving.description: Staff counters, tables and tills: take orders, serve food and drinks, run the casino floor, restock shelves.
defs.DesignationCategoryDef/HH_Hospitality.de: Signs, counters, shelves, tables and machines for guests: taverns, shops, casinos, spas, cinemas and, once you have found it, the back room.
defs.DesignatorDropdownGroupDef/HH_Group_Casi: Slot machines, gaming tables and the cashier's cage.
defs.DesignatorDropdownGroupDef/HH_Group_Well: Saunas, hot tubs and massage tables.
defs.DesignatorDropdownGroupDef/HH_Group_City: Cinema screens, salon chairs, park benches and the taxi stand.
defs.DesignatorDropdownGroupDef/HH_Group_Unde: Doors, pits, counters and docks for the things nobody talks about. Only shown once you have discovered the underworld.
defs.ResearchTabDef/HH_Hospitality.label: Hospitality
